unit_of_assignment: none; early adoption is a phased policy decision and is not randomized
exposure_mechanism: 12 municipalities adopt a mobile youth-crisis response policy at month 19; 12 municipalities remain not-yet adopters during the 36-month study window
target_estimand: average effect of the mobile youth-crisis response policy among the 12 early-adopter municipalities during months 19-36, compared with their counterfactual outcomes without the policy
warning: This simulation is not a validated model of youth crisis services. Early adoption is not randomized, pre-period diagnostics cannot prove parallel trends, and the same-month regional hotline contaminates a treated-only interrupted time-series interpretation.
causal_structure: municipality attributes affect early adoption and outcome levels
calendar month affects all municipalities through common trend and seasonality
a region-wide hotline begins for every municipality at month 19
the mobile response policy begins only in early-adopter municipalities at month 19
municipality-specific serially correlated shocks affect monthly outcomes

structural_equations.early_adopter: fixed fictional phased-adoption indicator with three early and three not-yet adopters per region
structural_equations.regional_hotline_active: 1 from month 19 onward in every municipality; 0 before month 19
structural_equations.youth_emergency_transports_per_10000: municipality level + common trend + seasonal terms + region term - 1.05*regional_hotline_active - 1.70*policy_active + AR(1) municipality shock

missing_value_code: none; all eight fields are complete

variables.name: municipality_id
variables.role: synthetic municipality identifier and clustering unit

variables.name: region
variables.role: fictional regional context used to balance adoption groups in the generator

variables.name: month_index
variables.role: calendar-time index and month fixed-effect identifier

variables.name: relative_month
variables.role: time relative to policy and hotline start
variables.unit: month_index minus 19; 0 is the first intervention month

variables.name: policy_active
variables.role: mobile youth-crisis response policy exposure used in the primary DiD

site_or_time_variables: 24 fictional municipalities in four fictional regions observed for 36 complete months
